study: International Cosmic Day coordinated cosmic-ray muon study

location.room_or_site_notes: FILL IN: room, floor, indoor/outdoor and shielding above detectors

detectors.model: CosmicWatch v2, original 16 MHz ATmega328P Nano
detectors.master_physical_id: FILL IN: unique label on top detector
detectors.slave_physical_id: FILL IN: unique label on bottom detector

geometry.orientation: Horizontal active surfaces, one above the other, centered on the same vertical axis
geometry.notes: Nominal original v2 dimensions. Replace with actual measurements. Separation is between active surfaces, not cases. Record which surfaces define the measurement.

coincidence.method: Original D6 level sampling with two A3 ADC conversions; firmware CW_CONT_1.0.0
coincidence.window_note: Not independently measured/calibrated on these boards; do not claim a precise window.

time.source: Windows system clock at serial receipt
time.notes: Confirm Windows date/time sync before recording. Nano uptime is independent and not an absolute UTC clock.

environment.notes: Optional separate weather measurements need timestamps and units. temp_adc is a detector-board sensor, not calibrated ambient temperature.
